units.source_text: 月底，一个刮大风的日子。

en.t: It was the end of the month, on a day when a strong wind was blowing.

units.source_text: 母亲不知道是因为感冒，还是嘴上长了一颗足有谷粒大小的肿疮的缘故，说自己身体不太舒服，早饭都没胃口吃。

en.t: My mother, perhaps because she had caught a cold or because a boil the size of a grain had formed on her mouth, said she did not feel well and had no appetite even for breakfast.

units.source_text: 我和母亲一起收拾完厨房之后，母亲一只手放在额头上，低垂着头看着火炉。

en.t: After my mother and I finished tidying the kitchen together, she rested one hand on her forehead and looked down at the brazier with her head lowered.

units.source_text: 很快，到了正午时候，她忽然抬起头来。

en.t: Before long, when noon came, she suddenly raised her head.

units.source_text: 我看到母亲嘴上的肿疮红的像番茄。

en.t: I saw that the boil on my mother's mouth was as red as a tomato.

units.source_text: 再看她眼睛迸发出不同寻常的光辉，就知道她是在发高烧。

en.t: Then, seeing an unusual light flashing in her eyes, I knew she had a high fever.

units.source_text: 认清这个现实之火，我吓了一跳，什么也不管不顾了，直接冲出去找到爸爸。

en.t: Once I recognized the fire of that reality, I was startled, threw everything else aside, and rushed straight out to find my father.
